interface A {
  x: string;
}
class A {
  constructor(public x = 1) {}
}
class B {
  constructor(public x = "b") {}
}
interface B {
  x: string;
}
class D {
  constructor(public x?: number) {}
}
interface D {
  x?: number;
}
class E {
  constructor(public x?: number) {}
}
interface E {
  x: number | undefined;
}
class F {
  constructor(public x: number | string = 1) {}
}
interface F {
  x: number;
}
class G {
  constructor(public x = 1) {}
}
interface G {
  x: string;
}
console.log(new G().x, new A().x, new B().x, new D().x, new E().x, new F().x);
